digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery orchestration
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py exceed the 800 LOC CI module-size cap and cannot be edited without extraction
completion.py conflates four distinct concerns: orchestration, child-closure gate, epic bug-screen filtering, and verdict reconciliation
completion_recovery.py conflates three distinct concerns: criteria/bounds/coverage, failure taxonomy, and CompletionAgentStep orchestration
decomposition must separate concerns into distinct modules with clear contractual boundaries while preserving all public seams and re-exports for backward compatibility
all moved symbols must remain patchable at their original dotted paths via facade re-exports and repointing of internal consumers
test suites require import-path and monkeypatch-target updates only; no assertion or behavior changes
